course_description: An introduction to linear algebra and differential equations with emphasis on the relationship between the theory of linear algebra and analytical and numerical techniques for solving differential equations. Linear algebra topics include linear systems, matrices and their algebra, vector spaces and linear transformations, eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Topics from differential equations include first order ODE, homogeneous and nonhomogeneous linear systems, and numerical methods. Enroll Info: None
course_summary: Introduction to linear algebra and differential equations with a focus on the relationship between linear algebra and solving differential equations. Topics include linear systems, vector spaces, eigenvalues, first order ODE, and numerical methods.
learning_outcomes:
- Verify properties in linear algebra and differential equations.
- Resolve algebraic statements and compute solutions to equations.
- Check premises of theorems for application.
- Express mathematical arguments in English.
- Recall and state definitions and theorems.
what_you_will_learn:
- Linear and differential equations resolution.
- Algebraic problems solving.
- Mathematical arguments articulation.
- Understanding eigenvalues and vector spaces.
- Application of theorems on linear algebra.
